parameters.scope: 46 single LP2 pages of at least200 runes followed by10 existing groups; all55 unknown rune pages represented, empty numeric LP2-50 preserved. Group boundaries and page resets are hypotheses.
parameters.solver: Frozen E068 screen22736 families,top8per period,232 full optimizations,12 refinements. a,b1..28,m4..32,no skips. Histogram objective checked by direct symbol evaluation. No key/language reset within an input. Same parameters for observed/null.
parameters.selection: Highest mean fourgram score among56 inputs, stable plan order for ties. Freeze winner and all56 output hashes before nulls.
parameters.null: 19 independent selected-input nulls, per-page interior shuffle preserving counts,endpoints,adjacent-equality and empty spans; rejection cap100000/page. Entire family screening and optimizer repeated.
parameters.inference: Plus-one p=(1+exceedances)/20; Bonferroni56 across page/group selection irrespective of overlaps. Minimum adjusted p is1 with19nulls. Coarse rejection screen only, no significance claim; zero exceedances requires separately preregistered larger calibration.
parameters.limits: Heuristic top8 screening; control success does not prove exhaustiveness. No additive constant, skipped runes or hidden resets. Source grouping not authenticated. No community claims.

extension_plan.algorithm: Frozen E068 solver and E069 per-page matched null sampler; no new tuning, candidate selection, or altered initializers. Each null repeats all22736-family screening and232-family search.
extension_plan.inference: Fresh99 only: plus-one p=(1+fresh exceedances)/100, Bonferroni56. Original19 are descriptive, never pooled into an adaptively stopped pvalue. No early stopping or promotion before all99 and independent audit. Minimum corrected p0.56, no significance claim; zero fresh exceedances leaves larger calibration pending.
extension_plan.limits: Follow-up was triggered by the original0/19 screen. This finite follow-up may reject an apparent lead but cannot establish corrected significance at0.05. Source/algorithm and selection remain immutable.
